results.segment: This notice concerns your membership and is sent for information. No reply is needed.

obligations.ask: Notify the office of your new address

results.segment: If you have moved abroad, notify the office of your new address.

results.segment: Should the tenancy end early, return all keys to the managing agent.
Ask for help with reading this letter if you need it.
Move valuables before the survey begins.
Membership remains valid to March 2029 under the existing number.
